title: "waiting for service to become available" in ros2 service call, and wait_for_service returning False: causes and fixes, measured
excerpt: Wrong name, namespace, remap, wrong type, other ROS_DOMAIN_ID, mixed RMW, a server that never spins or already exited: what the CLI, ros2 service list -t and node info show for each, exit codes, discovery delay and Lyrical's --timeout. Measured in rclpy and rclcpp on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical.
